findings.issue: Not-found handled via {notFound:true} sentinel unions and manual <NotFoundPage/> branches in four route components instead of the framework's throw notFound() + notFoundComponent/defaultNotFoundComponent; duplicates per-route and forgoes router 404 machinery.
findings.suggestion: Throw notFound() inside the server functions (or use notFoundComponent on each route) and register a defaultNotFoundComponent on the router; delete the sentinel unions.

findings.issue: No defaultErrorComponent is configured, so a non-404 upstream API failure renders the router's raw default error page with no site chrome and no recovery link.
findings.suggestion: Add a defaultErrorComponent that wraps the site layout with a friendly message and a link home, matching the official router examples.

findings.issue: Single module holds all API record types, the global cache, and shaping logic for all six pages; every route and both shared components import from it.
findings.suggestion: Split by resource (species/pokemon, moves, abilities, types) keeping the shared cache and apiGet in one small module; the docs' users.server.ts/users.functions.ts pattern scales better per-domain.

findings.issue: Failed /pokemon fetch silently returns a card without types, violating the home-page card requirement under partial API failure and hiding errors.
findings.suggestion: Log the failure, or let it propagate to the error component rather than swallowing it.

findings.issue: Dead helpers trackable, formatHeight, formatWeight, compareText; the height/weight logic is duplicated inline at data.server.ts:588-589.
findings.suggestion: Delete unused helpers or use them from data.server.ts to remove the duplication.

findings.issue: Module-level promise cache is unbounded and never invalidates; in a long-running process 'live' API changes never appear (spec permits memory caching, so this is a policy note).
findings.suggestion: Add a TTL or document the staleness trade-off next to the cache.

findings.issue: Title falls back to ' – Pokédex' while loaderData is undefined on client navigations (same pattern in moves/abilities/types routes).
findings.suggestion: Guard: omit the title until loaderData exists, or default to 'Pokédex'.

findings.issue: Plugin order nitro() before viteReact() differs from the official start-basic example (tanstackStart, viteReact, nitro); only the tanstackStart-before-react ordering is documented as required.
findings.suggestion: Match the official example order: tanstackStart(), viteReact(), nitro().

findings.issue: eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps with no eslint configured; the debounce effect depends on a render-captured update().
findings.suggestion: Add eslint (react-hooks) and/or extract the debounce into a small custom hook so dependency correctness is checked.

findings.issue: MoveTable key uses search.game ?? data.selectedGame instead of the loader's authoritative selectedGame.
findings.suggestion: Key on data.selectedGame for consistency with the rest of the component.

summary: This is a genuinely idiomatic current TanStack Start app: getRouter, HeadContent/Scripts shell, createServerFn+validator with a clean .server.ts/wrapper split, and URL-driven search state all match the current docs and skills. The main review asks are replacing the hand-rolled not-found sentinel pattern with notFound()/notFoundComponent, adding an error component, and splitting the 780-line god data module. No correctness bugs beyond minor silent error-swallowing and an unbounded cache that the spec permits.
